metadata.description: Curated primary sources for API contract testing, compatibility gates, schema validation, and mixed-protocol contract workflows.
metadata.title: QA Api Testing Contracts - Sources

specifications.name: OpenAPI Specification v3.2.1
specifications.relevance: Published 3.2 feature set; patch releases clarify text without adding features. Check the specification index and the whole toolchain before choosing a document version.

specifications.name: OAI sig-moonwalk (OpenAPI 4.0 / "Project Moonwalk")
specifications.relevance: OpenAPI 4.0 design effort. Check the SIG's current status before relying on it; while it has no stable specification, keep using OpenAPI 3.x and do not plan contract-testing pipelines around 4.0 features.

specifications.name: JSON Schema (2020-12)
specifications.relevance: Core validation model used by OpenAPI 3.1+ and related tooling.

specifications.name: AsyncAPI Specification v3.1.0
specifications.relevance: Contract surface for event-driven APIs, messages, and channels. Check the published specification index and consuming tools before selecting a version.

specifications.name: Arazzo Specification v1.1.0
specifications.relevance: Workflow contract format for multi-step API outcomes; the 1.1 feature set includes AsyncAPI steps, JSONPath/XPath, and $self. Select a version supported by the runner/validator. Send completion does not establish broker acknowledgment or delivery.

specifications.name: OpenAPI Initiative – Arazzo Specification Overview
specifications.relevance: OAI landing page for Arazzo: purpose, current version (check the page), and conformance test suite. AsyncAPI workflow support shipped in 1.1.0.

specifications.name: GraphQL Specification
specifications.relevance: Schema and execution semantics for GraphQL APIs.

specifications.name: gRPC Documentation
specifications.relevance: RPC design and operational guidance for gRPC services.

specifications.name: Protocol Buffers Documentation
specifications.relevance: Schema definition and compatibility rules for protobuf messages.

specifications.name: RFC 9457: Problem Details for HTTP APIs
specifications.relevance: Current standard problem-details envelope for HTTP APIs; obsoletes RFC 7807.

tools.name: Spectral
tools.relevance: Artifact linting and style governance for OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo documents.

tools.name: Prism
tools.relevance: Schema-aware mock server and request/response validator for OpenAPI and Postman collections.

tools.name: oasdiff
tools.relevance: OpenAPI diff and breaking-change detection for PR gates. Org moved from Tufin to oasdiff; repo renamed. Requires --fail-on ERR to exit non-zero on breaking changes.

tools.name: Pact Documentation
tools.relevance: Consumer-driven contract testing, verification, and broker workflows.

tools.name: Pact Broker `can-i-deploy`
tools.relevance: Primary deployment-safety gate for Pact-based compatibility management.

tools.name: PactFlow
tools.relevance: Hosted Pact platform with broker, bi-directional workflows, and optional AI features.

tools.name: PactFlow Bi-Directional Contract Testing
tools.relevance: Primary reference for BDCT: how consumer contracts are cross-verified against provider OpenAPI specs server-side, when BDCT fits over classic CDC, and its tradeoffs. PactFlow-exclusive feature; not in open-source Pact Broker.

tools.name: PactFlow Agent Skills (formerly PactFlow MCP Server, Oct 2025)
tools.relevance: IDE-assisted contract/Drift test generation and workspace queries. Check supported clients, product editions, authentication, and permissions at the linked installation docs before adopting.

tools.name: PactFlow Drift
tools.relevance: Spec-driven, OpenAPI-first API testing (CLI + CI-native) that validates whether a provider implementation matches its published spec, with AI-generated test scaffolding from the spec. Complements CDC/BDCT by answering 'does the provider spec reflect reality?' rather than 'are consumers compatible?'.

tools.name: Specmatic
tools.relevance: Executable contracts, backward-compatibility checks, and mixed protocol support. Specmatic 2.0 added GraphQL and gRPC support; Confirm current protocol support (Arazzo, Avro, MCP, WSDL) against docs.specmatic.io/supported_protocols before citing specifics.

tools.name: Schemathesis
tools.relevance: Property-based test generation and schema validation for OpenAPI and GraphQL. v4.0.0 released June 10, 2025 — full engine rewrite with breaking CLI changes: --hypothesis-max-examples renamed to --max-examples, --base-url renamed to --url, --show-trace and --validate-schema removed, schemathesis.io-related flags removed, new --phases/--report options, and a new schemathesis.toml config file.

tools.name: Schemathesis v3 to v4 Migration Guide
tools.relevance: Required reading before updating CI scripts from Schemathesis v3. Documents renamed flags, removed options (--app, --show-trace, schemathesis.io-related), and new --phases / --report options.

tools.name: Microcks
tools.relevance: Mocking and executable contract testing across API protocols. Check documentation for the selected version and artifact/binding support.

tools.name: Keploy
tools.relevance: Traffic-capture and replay workflow for bootstrapping regression tests on existing APIs.

tools.name: Buf
tools.relevance: Linting and breaking-change detection for protobuf and gRPC contracts.

tools.name: GraphQL Inspector
tools.relevance: Schema diffing and local GraphQL breaking-change checks.

tools.name: GraphQL Hive Schema Registry
tools.relevance: Schema registry and conditional GraphQL breaking-change checks using collected operations.

tools.name: Apollo GraphOS Schema Checks
tools.relevance: GraphQL build, operations, lint, and downstream contract checks.

tools.name: Postman Documentation
tools.relevance: Functional testing, governance, and optional AI-assisted exploration. Check current feature availability and agent permissions before adopting or granting write access.

tools.name: Dredd (ARCHIVED — do not use for new work)
tools.relevance: Dredd (apiaryio) was archived by the owner on November 8, 2024 — repository is read-only and no longer maintained. Confirm the Apiary hosted product's status before citing it. Replace with Schemathesis, Specmatic, or Prism for provider-spec verification in BDCT workflows.

security.name: OWASP API Security
security.relevance: Security risk model for API security baselines, including authorization, resource consumption, and unsafe API consumption.
